title: vnms
code:
LOD T1 // Load the first number
SUB T2 // Compare the numbers by subtraction
JMZ 11 // Stop if they are equal
LOD T1 // Load the original first number
STO X // Save the first number in X
LOD T2 // Load the original second number
STO Y // Save the second number in Y
LOD Y // Load the saved second number
STO T1 // Place it in T1
LOD X // Load the saved first number
STO T2 // Place it in T2
HLT // Stop execution
